title: hieracium laurinum subsp. vasconicum
intro: Hieracium laurinum subsp. vasconicum, commonly known as the Spanish hawk's beard, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium laurinum subsp. vasconicum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which make it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
